# dna dnssec

DNSSEC (DS records) of domains.

## dna dnssec add

```
dna dnssec add <domain> [flags]
```

Publish DS records at the registry (enable DNSSEC).

Adds DS records from your DNS provider. Wrong DS records make the domain unresolvable for validating
resolvers - copy them exactly.

- **Safety:** changes data (free)
- **API:** `POST /api/v1/domains/dns/dnssec`
- **Body:** `DnssecAddInput`
- **Returns:** `ListResultDto<DnssecOperationResultBaseDto>`
- **Schema:** `dna schema dnssec.add` (MCP tool: `dnssec_add`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `--records` | string | DS records as JSON: [{"keyTag":2371,"algorithm":13,"digestType":2,"digest":"..."}] (JSON, @file or -) (required; or --ds) |
| `--ds` | strings | DS record as "KEYTAG ALGORITHM DIGESTTYPE DIGEST" (as shown by your DNS provider); repeatable |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
# KEYTAG ALGORITHM DIGESTTYPE DIGEST
dna dnssec add example.com --ds "2371 13 2 1F987CC6583E92DF0890718C42..."
```

## dna dnssec disable

```
dna dnssec disable <domain> [flags]
```

Remove every DS record (disable DNSSEC).

- **Safety:** DESTRUCTIVE - deletes data or is hard to undo; asks for confirmation (--yes to skip)
- **API:** `POST /api/v1/domains/dns/dnssec/disable`
- **Body:** `DnssecDomainInput`
- **Returns:** `DnssecOperationResultBaseDto`
- **Schema:** `dna schema dnssec.disable` (MCP tool: `dnssec_disable`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

## dna dnssec remove

```
dna dnssec remove <domain> [flags]
```

Remove one DS record.

- **Safety:** DESTRUCTIVE - deletes data or is hard to undo; asks for confirmation (--yes to skip)
- **API:** `DELETE /api/v1/domains/dns/dnssec`
- **Returns:** `DnssecOperationResultBaseDto`
- **Schema:** `dna schema dnssec.remove` (MCP tool: `dnssec_remove`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `--digest` | string | Digest (required) |
| `--key-tag` | int | Key tag |
| `--algorithm` | string | IANA algorithm number or name [1=RsaMd5, 3=Dsa, 5=RsaSha1, 6=DsaNsec3Sha1, 7=RsaSha1Nsec3Sha1, 8=RsaSha256, 10=RsaSha512, 12=EccGost, 13=EcdsaP256Sha256, 14=EcdsaP384Sha384, 15=Ed25519, 16=Ed448] |
| `--digest-type` | string | IANA digest type number or name [1=Sha1, 2=Sha256, 3=Gost, 4=Sha384] |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |
